artifact_role: one canonical prabirshrestha/vim-lsp client registration and configuration contract for perllsp; the reviewed shape every later Vim driver, fixture, and doc consumer must copy or reference instead of re-deriving (#11369)
claim_boundary: configuration_documented substrate only. This fragment launches nothing, provisions no Vim, proves no behavior, and creates no support claim. Host journeys and fixtures own behavior in later leaves.

subject_reference.binding: this configuration is valid for exactly the pinned upstream subject; changing the subject requires a reviewed update of both artifacts

command_identity.law: executable identity is exactly 'perllsp --stdio' unless a generic product authority changes it (#7691/#7760); any other argv is a contract violation, not a variant

root_uri_contract.consumption_rule: root markers, selection order, and filetype policy are consumed from #7762's manifest by reference; this contract defines no second marker policy and no second activation rule
root_uri_contract.workspace_folders_relation: experimental workspace folders stay disabled by default; see experimental_workspace_folders

workspace.includePaths: <workspace-contained relative directories resolved against the server root>

workspace_configuration_channel.positive_example_law: the single positive example field is perl.workspace.includePaths with a workspace-contained relative path ('lib'); an absolute or traversal path must never become the positive client example (#4998)

field_authority_mapping.rule: a Vim-local workspace setting is a client delivery channel, not a second server schema
field_authority_mapping.admitted_fields_authority: #6736 configuration authority catalog (crates/perl-lsp-rs-core/src/configuration_authority/catalog.rs): a field may be delivered through workspace/configuration only when its FieldAuthority sources include WorkspaceConfiguration
field_authority_mapping.preferred_source: .perl-lsp.toml remains the preferred shared project configuration source; client-local settings are a fallback channel
forbidden_here: introducing fields absent from the catalog

experimental_workspace_folders.law: remains off unless #10960 directly earns a compatible optional cell; enabling it by inference or convenience is a contract violation
experimental_workspace_folders.observation_mode_note: later actual-host proof may enable it explicitly inside its own governed observation mode without moving this default

allowed_hooks: lsp#get_server_status / lsp#collect_server_status inspection at stage boundaries
logging_and_status_hooks.law: hooks exist to produce retained wire/process evidence; they add no user-facing feature surface here

laws: executable identity is exactly perllsp --stdio unless a generic product authority changes it
#7762 remains the sole filetype/root authority; no marker policy is copied into this contract
.perl-lsp.toml remains the preferred shared project configuration source
Vim-local workspace settings are a client channel, not a second server schema
positive include-path examples are workspace-contained relative paths unless #4998 explicitly admits a trusted channel
no blanket .t/.pm/.cgi/.fcgi/POD/XS/template activation rule enters this shared client config
g:lsp_experimental_workspace_folders remains off unless #10960 directly earns a compatible optional cell

generated_consumption_rules.for_consumers: drivers, fixtures, and documentation consume this artifact plus the subject manifest by reference; copying these values into a new host script or doc surface creates a conflicting second authority and fails validation
redirect_targets: scripts/ux/vim_vim_lsp_smoke.sh consumes the pinned commit from the subject manifest
